name: Uniform-Fiber Factorization of Lawrence’s Conjecture
statement: $\mathsf{UOMFib}=\mathsf{Amp}$ holds exactly when both $\mathsf{UOMFib}=\mathsf{MaxMin}$ and $\mathsf{MaxMin}=\mathsf{Amp}$ hold. Moreover, $\mathsf{UOMFib}=\mathsf{MaxMin}$ exactly when every finite maximum class belongs to $\mathsf{UOMFib}$.
proof: The established chain is $\mathsf{UOMFib}\subseteq\mathsf{MaxMin}\subseteq\mathsf{Amp}$. Pc-minor closure of UOMFib makes inclusion of every maximum generator equivalent to inclusion of all MaxMin classes.
